parsed.production_notes: The central visual is a static, AI-generated image of an elderly Indian man next to a humanoid robot on a plane, which is surreal and typical of AI art. The other visuals are simple graphic overlays and app mockups.
parsed.interaction_pattern: Tutor corrects a learner's spontaneous wrong-English mistake, then addresses objections about cost and time.
parsed.audio_track: Spoken dialogue in Kannada between two characters, with one character speaking broken English. There is no background music.

characters.appearance: An elderly South Indian man, approximately in his late 60s or early 70s, with a dark complexion and a slim build. He has short, grey hair, a full grey beard and mustache, and wrinkled facial features.
characters.wardrobe: A simple short-sleeved white collared shirt, a brown and white plaid lungi (a sarong-like garment), and a red and white checkered cloth (thundu) draped over his left shoulder.
characters.demeanor: Initially hesitant and self-conscious about his English, later becoming curious and enthusiastic.

characters.appearance: A humanoid robot with a female-presenting face and physique. Its body is constructed from glossy white and grey panels, with visible mechanical joints at the neck, shoulders, elbows, and fingers. It has a defined, human-like facial structure with glowing blue eyes.
characters.demeanor: Helpful, patient, and encouraging, with a calm and clear speaking voice.

scenes.setting: Inside an airplane cabin during the day. The seats are dark blue, and soft light comes from the window.

panels.panel_visual_description: An elderly South Indian man (Character A) with grey hair and a beard sits in an airplane window seat, looking towards his seatmate. He is wearing a simple white shirt and a plaid lungi, with a red and white checkered cloth over his shoulder. Next to him sits a white, female-presenting humanoid robot (Character B), who is turned slightly towards the man. The robot has a sleek design with visible joints. The airplane cabin interior, including other seats and overhead compartments, is visible in the background.
